name: Dino Valley
lore: The road comes back down to earth in a warm green valley of ferns, rivers and smoking volcanoes, where dinosaurs fish, play music and get up to all sorts of things.
sourceNote: FLUX.1 [schnell] by Black Forest Labs (Apache-2.0), 4-bit GGUF, run on the studio's Mac; lane C's v2 full story scenes, 50 picks and 36 spares (game-research/sappers-path-v4/lands/05-dino-valley/README.md, 'v2 full story scenes'; picks-full.json). Kind painting (no outline: the other half of the ink-outline rule), thin line art stripped; six picks (dv201 dv205 dv216 dv293 dv314 dv308) carry one solid ink line round their hero, drawn into the source by lane C (README 'Hero outlines'; outlined/fullsrc). Each file is the whole picture, converted by land.js boardOf with its chroma steps. The folder keeps lane C's slug (05, the old factory plan); as installed it is Land 3 in the factory's numbering (levels 301-350, era 11) and Zen World 4.

zen.note: v6 lane D12: Dino Valley plays as Zen World 4 (tools/land.js ... zen writes levels/zen.json only; levels.json, gallery.json, layout.json and config.json are not touched). Its records keep the land factory numbers 301-350 (state.json from 301: Worlds 1-3 hold 1-36, 201-250, 251-300); the page shows them as Zen pictures 137-186 (main.js zenNum).

profile.note: Zen World 4, casual (v6 lane D12, 2026-10-08): Snack Galaxy's profile as it ships (tools/lands/02-snack-galaxy/land.json): Kitten Forest's casual tags E18/N26/H6/X0 ending on a Hard, light deck features (? cards, linked squads), no locks, no archers, no mystery blocks (Peter, 2026-10-08), gentle moats (a ring on a fifth of the Easy, two fifths of the Normal and two thirds of the Hard levels, always 2 ways in) on pictures that can carry one, and the careful floor 0.5 on every tag. The 50 are lane C's v2 full story scenes (painting kind); the order is lane D's (tools/land-05-notes.md).

hidden.note: v6 lane D8 (Peter, 2026-10-08): no mystery blocks in Zen, ever. The whole picture shows from the start; land.js and zen-world.js refuse a Zen land or world with hidden in its features or a hidden share.

eggNote: Eggs on the painted side-quest spurs' tips (World 1's rule; the land has no side quests, so no spur leads nowhere): eggTurns puts each sheet's 2 eggs on its template's 2 quest spots (sandy jungle clearings). Kinds from the drawn set that suit a jungle valley: grass (a rustle, a critter peeks out), glint (a rock with a gem, amber-like), woodpile (a campfire), bubble (a lava crust bubble: only on sheet A's upper clearing, the one beside the painted volcano), mushrooms. Not the space kinds (wisp, ember) or the castle's. The map README's hatchling, raptor, amber and pterosaur aren't drawn yet (LATER.md).
